title: Bug 657097: [master] Suggest Lines fails with a duplicate ECSL VAT Report Line Relation record in GB environment
summary: Fixed EC Sales List Suggest Lines in GB environment to process each VAT entry only once, preventing duplicate VAT Report Line Relation records and incorrect report totals.
key_points: VAT entries appearing in multiple query rows were being processed repeatedly
Duplicate ECSL VAT Report Line Relation records are now prevented
Report totals and VAT-entry relations are generated correctly
Fix includes regression tests covering group rounding and rejected/accepted prior reports
quote: Process each VAT entry once so report totals and VAT-entry relations are not duplicated.
